quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on Charlotte Hornets' focus for the upcoming season
quotes.excerpt: It's just controlling what we can now. I think obviously we know who Brooklyn has

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Preseason games just out of curiosity, how much of it is you guys really focusing on what you need to get done as you ramp up for the regular season? Is there any sort of matchup specific stuff you're looking at or is it more just control what you can, you're not really worried about what Brooklyn is doing?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Miller
text_blocks.text: It's just controlling what we can now. I think obviously we know who Brooklyn has as far as players, what Tennessee do they have, but I think just knowing the basics, the controlling the controllables, will be our focus tonight.

quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller says the Hornets are focused on controlling what they can control during the preseason rather than worrying about specific matchups like Brooklyn.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on the importance of physicality in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: We feel like more teams are playing us more physical. When it comes down to the playoffs

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Another one of the focal points this season you guys have talked a lot about is physicality. How have you seen an increased attention to playing with more physicality so far in camp?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Miller
text_blocks.text: We feel like more teams are playing us more physical. When it comes down to the playoffs, play-in, the game is a lot more physical. So being prepared for physicality like that playoff environment is always good for us early on in the season. We still have to keep the mindset of being smart while we're playing physical. Physicality can go a long way. That's one thing that hurt us last year, but I think we'll be more prepared this year for a lot more physicality.

quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller says the Hornets are prioritizing physicality this season to prepare for a playoff environment, noting that a lack of physicality hurt the team last year.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on the mental and physical toll of NBA play
quotes.excerpt: You're playing a whole game physical, your body's not feeling the best. So just having things to lean on

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How much of playing with physicality is a mental approach?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Miller
text_blocks.text: It's everything. It's a toll. You're playing a whole game physical, your body's not feeling the best. So just having things to lean on like teammates, coaching staff, whatever the case may be, is always good to have.

quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller emphasizes the mental toll of playing a physical style of basketball, noting that leaning on teammates and the coaching staff is essential for getting through the season.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on team-wide contributions and Charlotte Hornets' identity
quotes.excerpt: I don't ever single no one out. I think we do this as a whole. That's why we wear Charlotte Hornets

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Preseason is obviously big for veterans to knock off some of the rust for the regular season starters, but it's a time for younger players to salvage themselves in the rotation. Is there anybody you're excited to watch tonight specifically?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Miller
text_blocks.text: Everybody. I don't ever single no one out. I think we do this as a whole. That's why we wear Charlotte Hornets, it's never just about one player. So just everybody is going to be involved contributing tonight. I'm excited just to be back out there with the guys and support them and cheer them on with the fans.

quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller emphasizes team identity over individual performance, stating that the Hornets success is about everyone contributing as a whole.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Miller
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Miller on his growing leadership role with the Hornets
quotes.excerpt: I think just leading more vocally. My voice is being heard around the building here.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Matt talked about veterans. You said during media day that you're kind of one of the older guys on the team now. How do you feel kind of taking that leadership step? What's that jump like going from year three to the fourth season?

text_blocks.speaker: Brandon Miller
text_blocks.text: I think just leading more vocally. My voice is being heard around the building here. Carrying that out as one of the leaders here is good for the team and this 82-game season. Just building bonds early. That's one thing that I've always preached on is bonds and trust. One thing that comes along with this 82-game season is building trust as the season goes on and I think it's going to get stronger as the day goes on.

quotes.social_post: Brandon Miller is embracing a more vocal leadership role for the Hornets this season, focusing on building bonds and trust within the locker room for the long 82 game grind.
